response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed systems experience with event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq), but lacks direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or fintech-specific infrastructure (e.g., credit risk, working-capital management). While he demonstrates leadership scaling teams and open-source contributions, his background is more generalist and lacks the depth required for a CTO role in agentic AI fintech.
strengths: Deep expertise in event-driven architectures and distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Experience leading engineering teams and improving development practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, DevOps at Altom Consulting)
Recent involvement in AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows at re:cinq)
concerns: No documented experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or regulated fintech environments
Limited exposure to fintech-specific domains (e.g., credit risk, payment flows, embedded finance)
Lacks hands-on experience with real-time inference systems, rate limits, or AI-system reliability in high-stakes settings
